author: LLMC02
quote: The most fun game I've ever played. It's honestly unbelievable how fun the gameplay is. I spent hour and hours and hours on ice hockey, and would do it again if this game was ported.
game_title: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Winter Games

author: LLMC02
quote: Amazing characters, impressive story, a rich world, it's honestly impressive how they nailed all of this in 1997. The only game that created a perfect harmony between characters, world, story, music, and gameplay.

author: LLMC02
quote: The best story of any videogame, ever. So well done in every single way. Also one of the most immersive digital worlds ever created. I often spend many hours exploring between missions, and get lost, and loose track of time while doing so. The attention to detail is crazy, and you can really feel everything that was put into this game. Probably my favourite playstation game ever.

author: LLMC02
quote: One of the best of all time. A massive explosion of ideas, all incredibly well executed (not really sure how they did it in 2007 but they did), with amazing moments of an emotional story, and everything is incredibly well balanced. The cherry on top is the incredible soundtrack.

author: LLMC02
quote: A proper video game. Fun, crazy, creative, everything you could wish for. Lacks a bit of the emotional story from the first one but makes up for it with improved gameplay. Can't tell you how many hours I spent on this game over the years.

author: LLMC02
quote: Absolutely fantastic game, I often get lost exploring and finding different ways to go where I'm supposed to. The option to choose your move set is incredible both from design and player view. Amazing game

author: LLMC02
quote: Thank god there's still someone making magical games in 2026. A truly immersive experience, building on the near-perfect original game and modernising it. A must play.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: LLMC02
quote: If the game is literally named after stealing cars, why would they limit your ability to do that? I'm yet to have fun in the story, lot's of boring things to do, not a lot of action so far. I was expecting more. Great graphics and filler content are not enough to excuse that despite the amount of money and time spent on this game's production, they couldn't get the game to run on 60 fps, and sometimes not even hold the 30 fps, which is a disgrace; the characters have no personality whatsoever and you spend a lot of time doing stupid tasks and not having fun. GTA 6 does not beat GTA 5's fun gameplay, it does not beat RDR 2's story, and its performance does not hold up in modern standards. What a shame, I really had incredibly high hopes for this.
